# Eight men on a raft: Soar agent from the Rosie teaching script

**Runnable.** `eight-men-raft.soar` loads the shared library (`Soar/soar-library`, v2.42) and `eight-men-raft-rules.soar` (14 task rules, generated by `gen.py` from the statements in `english-input.txt`; `tools/rosie_swap.py`). Generated 18 Nov 2026. Needs Soar 9.6.6 (or the PyPI soar-sml bindings).

## Run

    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . eight-men-raft.soar --seed 1 --cap 60000
    python3 ../../tools/run_agent.py . eight-men-raft.soar --json | python3 ../../tools/check_moves.py eight-men-raft init-8men.world

`python3 gen.py WORLD` writes the same rules with another example state as the initial world.

## Results (library v2.42, 18 Nov 2026)

Example states (`gen.py WORLD`, `run_agent.py --check`): init-8men: goal false, failure false; final-8men: goal true, failure false; second-8men: goal false, failure false.

Seeds 1-3, cap 60,000 decisions; plans replayed independently by `check_moves.py` (legality from the action statements, the losing conditions, the goal).

| Seed | Outcome | Decisions | Actions | Replay |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | success | 12,159 | 24 | goal holds |
| 2 | cap | 60,000 | 9 | goal does not hold |
| 3 | success | 14,530 | 24 | goal holds |

## Translation

- Operator move (argument1 = the peg, argument2 = the clear location it moves onto); four proposals, one per move
  statement (4, 7, 9, 10). Every block is a peg (statement 6). Blue pegs step right and jump right over any peg; red pegs
  step left and jump left over any peg.
- clear is a maintained one-argument relation (statement 5); left-of and right-of are static relations between locations,
  and a peg is to the left/right of a location when the location it is on is (A-S1).
- The goal (statement 15) is expanded over the blocks of the world file (A-S2). "The solution has twenty-four steps"
  (statement 11) is checked against the plans, not used.
Propose initialize-eight-men-raft when its conditions below hold.

The assumption codes (A-S, A-G, A-C, A-P) are explained in `tools/rosie_swap.py` and `../../PILOT.md`.
